facts.fact: The Supabase MCP server blog post was published on 4 April 2025.
According to Supabase, there are over 20 tools available in the Supabase MCP server.
facts.quote: There are over 20 tools available in the Supabase MCP server.

facts.fact: According to the page, the latest revision of the Model Context Protocol spec at the time of writing was dated 2025-03-26.
facts.quote: The latest revision of the MCP spec (2025-03-26 as of writing) now includes official [authorization support]

facts.fact: Supabase states that connecting the MCP server requires a personal access token, which authenticates the MCP server with the user's Supabase account.
facts.quote: This token authenticates the MCP server with your Supabase account.
